decisions.target: small business owners with a Cobalt card reader

actions.action: Savings boost on new money only, 4 weeks
Early pay up to 2 days early, permanently

decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. For the next 4 weeks, new money you add to Cobalt savings earns an extra 0.5 points, on balances up to $50,000. Paychecks paid into Cobalt can now show up to 2 days early, so Friday Dec 11 pay may arrive by Wed Dec 9. We have added 150 support staff for the coming weeks.
decisions.why:
Chosen by the optimizer for week 5 (small business owners with a Cobalt card reader).
Actions: Savings boost on new money only, 4 weeks, Early pay up to 2 days early, permanently, Extra support staff for 4 weeks.
Cost $2,000,000 of the $4M budget.

decisions.message: Thank you for your patience in recent weeks. For the next 4 weeks, new money you add to Cobalt savings earns an extra 0.5 points, on balances up to $50,000. If you need it, you can get a zero-interest advance of up to $500, repaid from your next deposit. We have added 150 support staff for the coming weeks.
